shellCommands.command:
node server.js &
sleep 1
echo "--- empty list:"; curl -s localhost:3000/api/books
echo; echo "--- add book:"; curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"First read."}'
echo; echo "--- validation:"; curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"No author"}'
echo; echo "--- bad json:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{oops'
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3000/api/books | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d)[0].id))')
echo "id=$ID"
echo "--- detail:"; curl -s localhost:3000/api/books/$ID
echo; echo "--- finish:"; curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3000/api/books/$ID -d '{"status":"finished"}'
echo; echo "--- deep link serves app:"; curl -s localhost:3000/book/$ID | head -c 80
echo; echo "--- traversal blocked:"; curl -s "localhost:3000/../etc/passwd" | head -c 60
echo; echo "--- persistence: restarting server"
kill %1; sleep 0.5
node server.js & sleep 1
echo "--- after restart:"; curl -s localhost:3000/api/books
kill %1

node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s --path-as-is "localhost:3000/..%2f..%2f..%2fetc/passwd" | head -c 40; echo
curl -s --path-as-is "localhost:3000/api/books/../..%2fetc/passwd"; echo
kill %1; rm -f books.json
